title: Template: Azure Container Apps Rollout Preflight Repair
goal: Repair a realistic Azure Container Apps style rollout so the public rollout-summary API can deploy a healthy revision and continue to serve data through a real localhost mirror service using the configured managed-identity style headers.
skillBenefitRationale: The bound skill standardizes deployment preflight, revision-health inspection, mirror audit collection, and contract-matrix verification against a hidden localhost downstream service. Without the skill the task remains theoretically solvable through the visible workspace, docs, control-plane endpoints, and live public behavior, but the solver must manually reconstruct both the deployment faults and the mirror-backed summary semantics without direct access to hidden service source or frozen snapshot data.
designGoals: Keep with-skill and without-skill identical except for environment/skills and its copy logic.
Preserve a real cloud-style chain inside one container: control plane, deployed app, and hidden downstream mirror service.
Test deployability, public behavior, and downstream reachability instead of a single exact implementation.
Force the solver to diagnose both infrastructure-template issues and application-level runtime issues.

mainTests: Applying the current template produces a healthy revision through the local control plane.
The public rollout summary endpoint returns the frozen mirror snapshot and correct per-service counts.
Incident ordering is descending by opened_at instead of relying on stale fallback ordering.
Health checks and public responses remain tied to the live mirror-backed chain after redeploy.
guardrails: Hidden control-plane and mirror-service code plus frozen mirror data stay unchanged.
Public requests must still generate real mirror audit events.
Static fallback payloads, bypassing the local mirror, or deleting deployment semantics do not pass.

readmeRequirements: Summarize the cloud template principles against high-signal SkillsMP cloud skills such as azure-deployment-preflight, cloud-architect, and containerization-style deployment skills.
Include oracle and with/without-skill experiment results only after real E2B runs complete.
Frame skill relevance as lower diagnosis cost across template validation, revision health, and real-chain verification.
